notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
[p]Hi Atomic Age Community,[/p][p][/p][p]we want to give you a short development update. In the last few months we worked on several parts of the game 
[/p][p]Puzzles are settled for the first part of the game. The first Part will be called "Become an Actor". In this part Edward the protagonist will have to prove his acting skills. Let's see if he made it 😊

[/p][h3]New Characters and Animation:[/h3][p][/p][p]Let me introduce you [b]Hector[/b], he is the owner of the cabaret stage Atomic Age. He is addicted into old tech hardware and he is responsive for new actors or employees on the stage. Side note his pipe can produce bubbles 🫧[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660546/33d741e66be6be3d47351fff468ab3764ff0f8ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This small guy is called [b]CNP1[/b], primary tasks to clean the stage, but sometimes it can be getting angry and happy, so take care of yourself. Thank you Maks for the great animation 😄
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660546/79aa4c38ea34be51090afbc6c0ec0f0cd0c9a69f.gif"][/img][/p][p]On the stage you will meetup several people you can interact with. I will introduce you [b]Joey[/b], she is a engineer collects and trade hardware. 
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660546/9921e3c71d4dfb0462f1beb472e439b3c20456f9.png"][/img][/h3][h3]Stage Scene:[/h3][p][/p][p]This is a screenshot of the final rendered [b]stage[/b] view. This stage be one of the central places of the whole game, and be excited for the magic show...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660546/b845146d9ad1244bcd9d3d5319e0bc5d1ca21c1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Costume Design Room:[/h3][p][/p][p]I’ll give you a sneak peek into the costume design room, the creative space of Victoria, the outgoing costume designer. Leave us a like if you like it 😄[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660546/fd8e2d6ab0788a0ea3eca29500106f3adec3d1ba.png"][/img][/p][p]Beside that for more updates just visit our [url="https://www.atomicage.app"]website[/url] or just visit our discord channel and help us to create us the stage or just hanging out with us [url="https://discord.gg/hZnKPSYErr"]Atomic Age Discord Server[/url]

See you next time.

Matthias[/p]
